description: This is a high-resolution satellite photograph, captured on 2018-09-02, depicting the British coastline near Fairlight, UK. The image showcases an expansive sandy beach at the base of steep, rugged cliffs, with the clear blue open sea extending to the horizon. Multiple waves are visible breaking on the shore, creating white foam against the varying shades of turquoise and dark blue ocean water. The imagery is derived from SuperView-1 satellite data with 2m resolution, provided by Airbus DS Geo SA (2018), and credited to CCME 2018 under the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) by the European Union and ESA. This visual documentation supports the delineation and monitoring of coastal waters and the open sea, in line with definitions such as those found in the Water Framework Directive (Directive 2000/60/EC).
